title: apsarray
description: `apsarray` is an AutoPreset helper for a `moonlib/sarray`, referenced by a preset reference, name, and SArray name; the SArray itself is not included. Use it as `apsarray Ref Name SArrayName [SArrayLength [pat_no_all]]`, signal array-length changes to `$3-len-snd`, and set `pat_no_all` to 1 to prevent receiving the `_all_` pattern.
